scope: Frozen final acceptance tools; no hardware used by reviewer; no final product/precision acceptance
head: 8a1794ce3be95ff0007698c4e4e667dcf25fbe19
confirmed: Formal CDC and mode/SHORT CLI require full expected ELF/session/boot. Actual CONFIG/BUILD/CONFIG bracket, target esp32s3/project SensorArray/PROTO2 and full unchanged configuration domains precede first setter.

Failed authority or observed reset/changed CONFIG boot revokes setter permission. Cleanup with no verified preparation is not attempted. A fresh cleanup bracket binds the same expected boot/image; failed/changed identity prevents CAP/ROWS/USB/TX cleanup mutation.

50-mode and SHORT harness retain their bounded total deadline and raw/event coverage. SHORT lost setter ACK arms one restoration attempt; no blind setter replay; post-restore fault/reset/bytes and final event remain included.
32 cases comprise CAP/VOLT/RES/MIXED x rows1..8, each full120s after separate5s warmup. MIXED uses CVRCVRCV; one active C row is explicitly homogeneous. No automatic FPS caps or CAL=SAVE.

Each case starts separate BLE/debug observer processes, checks live process identity/readiness, runs formal collector, closes/joins observers, then uses real parser/protection analysis before continuing. First ERROR/FAIL/UNKNOWN or unknown child cleanup stops without automatic retry.
Forced child termination is recorded as unknown cleanup, never board SAFE. Observer/child bounded wait and PID identity/reap branches are covered with synthetic processes.

Gate verifies contiguous raw/event RX, hashes, one final finished record, actual raw query replies, prepare+cleanup authority brackets, CAPACITANCE/CAP8/CCCCCCCC final config, and closed BLE/debug coverage. No summary-only authority.

Fully contained BLE fragment/line CRC errors are distinct from boundary-straddling diagnostics; malformed unattributable/oversize DATA is UNKNOWN. Fault/reset diagnostics across the closed journal fail. Original scientific invalid points are retained and count as complete protocol frames when wire/identity/CRC valid.

Normal BLE endpoint loss ratio keeps its old definition and0.025 budget. Separate full-window evidence guard requires trustworthy first/last receipt within1s edges, device timestamp span >= requested-2s and captureFPS>=1; missing clocks/low-rate tests require manual review, not automatic threshold relaxation.

counterexample.observed: Two adjacent BLE frames amid10000 USB frames changed from PASS_NUMERIC_SCREEN to UNKNOWN. Maintained tests also provide valid host edges with two old device-adjacent frames and confirm UNKNOWN.

limits: A preflight cannot prevent a physical reset that has not yet been observed between query and setter; observed changes revoke authority.
One-second edge allowance is an offline observation sufficiency rule, not a firmware/snapshot/peer-delivery deadline.
Network notify admission/local completion does not establish PC receipt; actual BLE journal reassembly and trusted full frame are required.
The runner screens cases; required final10-minute/32-case hardware runs and precision/hardware limitations remain separate.
